variants.cockpit: Every switch of a VTOL VR cockpit is a virtual object pressed with the VR controller's fingertip. The flight controls are grabbed with the grip buttons; the controller's own trigger, buttons and thumbstick then become the stick's and throttle's HOTAS controls.
variants.notes: Default VR controller layout shared by the jets. Columns = the MFD page set as SOI (TGP, radar, NAV map / TSD): the stick thumbstick works on that page, the throttle thumbstick picks it (left / right) and zooms it (up / down; on the radar it tilts the elevation in SLEW mode). Grip, then trigger, then action button opens the game menu. A physical HOTAS needs the BYOJoystick mod (per-seat bindings of the same functions); the game alone binds only rudder and wheel brakes. Panels group the cockpit switches by system, item list from the BYOJoystick targets of this seat; where they sit in the cockpit is approximate (the wiki shows the cockpit only in pictures).

Documented defaults: the hat looks around (camera pitch / yaw), the nozzle axis is unbound. The other buttons are the game's actions (Fire Gun, Release Weapon, Lock Target, Select Next Weapon, Drop Chaff/Flare) on the usual places, not confirmed defaults. Other aircraft (F-5E, MiG-21bis, F-4E, MiG-23MLA) are AI-only. Further game actions without a default: Select Previous Weapon, Select Nav Mode, Toggle Flaps, Toggle Landing Gear, VTOL Raise / Lower Nozzle, Brakes (axis / momentary / toggle), Instantly Zero / Max Throttle, Toggle Engine, Eject.
